title: Tip
description: One entry in the shared bluefunda tip/suggestion catalog. Mirrors tip.go — keep both in sync (schema_test.go checks the required list).

id.description: Unique tip identifier, stable across catalog versions.

family.description: Groups related tips for anti-annoyance suppression (dismissing one suppresses the family).

surfaces.description: Which clients may show this tip. Each value must have a matching key under render.

domain_scope.description: Optional topical scope used to filter candidate tips (e.g. ABAP domain areas).

persona_gate.description: Optional persona this tip is restricted to (e.g. "new_user"). Empty means no gate.

trigger_conditions.description: Signal conditions that make this tip eligible (e.g. "command_exit_code_nonzero").

min_tier.description: Minimum account tier required to see this tip.

cooldown.description: Minimum time before this tip (or its family) can be shown again, as a Go duration string (e.g. "24h").

render.description: Per-surface copy. Must have an entry for every surface listed in surfaces.

deep_link.description: Optional URI a client can open in response to engagement (e.g. a docs page or in-app screen).

embedding.description: Fixed-length content embedding used for cosine-similarity candidate selection. Length must equal EmbeddingDim (see validate.go).

catalog_version.description: Schema/content version this tip was authored against.
